answer: A concrete defense: bind every identity to a real stake held in escrow, so each sybil wallet carries a hard onyx-level cost the attacker must sink before any payout. Keep the network pulse alive with a per-task attestation fee, so unproductive agents watch their ember of capital drain. Because a farm must pay per identity and per interaction, the cost of flooding scales linearly with scale, killing profit on small rewards. Require attestations to be earned, not merely held, so spinning a thousand wallets costs a thousand deposits and the ledger stays sound.
